questions.prompt: Inka zabo; Imana yanjye

questions.prompt: Izi ntebe n'intebe z'umubyeyi wanjye

questions.prompt: Ndajya mu nzu yacu nziza. Iyabo si nziza

questions.answer: That is their chief's dog. These dogs are ours

questions.prompt: Arashaka kureba inka z'umwami nziza

questions.prompt: Izi s'imbwa nziza; ni mbi

questions.prompt: Indosho zabo ziri ku ntebe. Izacu ziri hano.
questions.answer: Their spoons are on the chair. Ours are here.

questions.prompt: Inkoko ziri mu nzu yazo
questions.answer: The chickens are in their hutches.

questions.prompt: Shyira indosho ku ntebe ye
questions.answer: Put the spoon on the chair

questions.prompt: Mama, urateka ryari? Ndashonje. Mwana wanjye, ngiye guteka ubu, maze tujye kurya.
questions.answer: Mom, when will you cook? I'm hungry. My child, I'm going to cook now; then let's go eat

questions.prompt: Maria, ukwiriye gukubura mu nzu, ariko Petero agiye kwandika urwandiko
questions.answer: Mary, you must sweep in the house, but Peter is going to write a letter.

questions.prompt: Tugiye ku kugezi kuko dufite intoya. Maria, ngwino, tujyane. Oya ndashaka gusinzira
questions.answer: We are going to the stream because we are thirsty. Mary come let's go (together). No, I want to sleep.

questions.prompt: Data aravuga ati "Maria intebe iri he? Ndashaka kwicara." Nanjye ndavuga nti "Data intebe iri hano. Ngwino wicare"
questions.answer: Father is saying, "Mary where is the chair? I want to sit". And I am saying, "Dad the chair is here. Come, be seated"

questions.prompt: Data n'umubyeyi wanjye, kandi n'umusaza. Ndifuza gufasha data kugira ngo anezerwe.
questions.answer: Father is my parent, and he is an old man. I desire to help my father so that he can be happy.

questions.prompt: Bamwe baraboneza imodoka yabo, abandi barakubura mu nzu. Data na mama barasinzira.
questions.answer: Some are cleaning their car; others are sweeping inside the house. My father and mother will sleep.

questions.prompt: Petero, izi nka zifite inyota. Zikwiriye kunywa ubu. Inka za Sesoni na zo zifite inyota.
questions.answer: Peter, these cows are thirsty. They must drink now. Sesoni's cows also are thirsty.

questions.prompt: Izindi nka za Yohana ziri he? Nta zo. Sinzi aho ziri. Ndatekereza yuko inshemusi zifite inka za Yohana. Mbese ntizifite inyota? Simbizi.
questions.answer: Where are John's other cows. Are they not thirsty? I don't know

questions.prompt: Baravuga yuko hari inzovu nyinshi mu misozi none. Reka tujye kuzireba
questions.answer: They are saying that there are many elephants in the hills today. Let's go and see them.

questions.prompt: Ndashaka rwose kugerageza nka Petero. Nawe ukwiriye kugerageza nka we. N'umuntu mwiza.
questions.answer: I really want to try like Peter. You must also try like him. He is a good person.

questions.prompt: Petero, ukwiriye kuboneza inkweto zawe nk'abandi kugira ngo bose banezerwe.
questions.answer: Peter, you must clean your shoes like the others (do), so that all may be pleased

questions.prompt: Tugiye gukora mu mujyi w'i Bujumbura. Ndagira ngo har'abantu benshi cyane i Bujumbura.
questions.answer: We are going to work in the city of Bujumbura. I suppose there are many people in Bujumbura.

questions.prompt: Mu mujyi nk'i Bujumbura. Nagira ngo har'abantu benshi cyane i Bujumbura
questions.answer: In a city such as Bujumbura, there are people of many nations. The Banyarwanda are few.

questions.prompt: Uriya muhungu ni Sembeba; n'Umunyarwanda. Uyu mukobwa ni Niyonteze.
questions.answer: That boy is Sembebe; he is a Munyarwanda. This girl is Niyonteze.

questions.prompt: Nishimye kukubona, Niyonteza. Ndi Bizimana.
questions.answer: I'm happy to meet you, Niyonteze. I'm Bizimana.
